title: Squircle
description: Superellipse SVG tile with a glass gradient, a tinted drop shadow and an inner rim, clipping whatever is drawn on it to the same curve. Bare, it is the backdrop the tenant switcher's Blobatar sits on; the Avatar draws its photograph, initials or icon on it. Decorative by default.

anatomy.description: The <svg> root with data-slot="squircle", aria-hidden unless the caller overrides it; size (px, also the path's coordinate space), exponent (Lamé n, 5 by default), resolution, and the glass and shadow colours as CSS var strings.
The radial glass gradient on the path; it casts the squircle-shaped shadow for everything drawn over it.
SVG content the consumer draws on the pane (an <image>, a <text>, a nested <svg>), rendered in a group clipped to the curve, in the tile's own coordinate space (0 to size).
A 2px centred stroke clipped to a 1px inner bevel, the glass rim, drawn over the children.

usage: Pass colours as CSS var strings (the defaults are Juniper steps); SVG presentation attributes cannot hold var(), so they land through style attributes (theming §5.1).
Keep it decorative: the name or label beside it carries the meaning (component-architecture §5.4). Override aria-hidden and add role and aria-label only when nothing beside it names the thing.
Draw on it with SVG children sized against `size`; for a person, use Avatar rather than composing the faces again.
Size the rendered box from the consumer's CSS (width and height on the svg); size sets the viewBox and the path's resolution.
